source_note: SuperClaude 4.3.0 from PyPI (pipx install superclaude==4.3.0), installed with `superclaude install` into a throwaway HOME (no `superclaude mcp`, so no MCP servers) and copied unedited: .claude/commands/sc/ holds 31 files, which is the 30 slash commands `superclaude install --list` reports plus the README.md the installer also drops in that folder (it loads as /sc:README; kept because a normal install has it). .claude/agents/ holds the 20 agents. MIT licence, copy in SUPERCLAUDE_LICENSE. MCP check: 18 of the 30 commands list MCP servers in an `mcp-servers:` frontmatter key and in prose (/sc:implement names context7, sequential, magic, playwright; /sc:troubleshoot lists none). That key is not a Claude Code frontmatter field, no file sets allowed-tools or tools, and none names an mcp__ tool, so with --strict-mcp-config the commands load and simply run without those servers. Slash commands and the Agent tool are enabled on both sides so only SuperClaude differs. Prefixes: the three bugs (h1, h3, h4) run through `/sc:troubleshoot --type bug --fix`, the feature (h2) through `/sc:implement --with-tests`. Third-party files, so they were skipped in the hard-task hint check and stay unedited; none of them mentions frai. Evidence: https://dev.to/stevengonsalvez/superclaude-the-claudemd-framework-that-went-viral-1ced Task set and model changed on 15 Sep 2026 after the pilots (see PROTOCOL): t1, t2, t3 and h2 on Haiku 4.5, both sides.
